key_idea: The sky goes on top, and the shapes on the edges must join up.
steps: Two pieces have sky and two pieces have the house. The sky goes on top.
The red triangles must join into one hill: the piece with the sun goes left and the piece with the cloud goes right.
The two doors must meet in the middle: the plain wall goes left and the wall with the window goes right.

choice_feedback.A: The two red triangles slope away from each other, so they don't make one hill.
choice_feedback.B: The doors are on the outside edges, so they don't meet in the middle.
choice_feedback.D: The sky is at the bottom.
choice_feedback.E: Each row mixes a sky piece with a house piece.
